column `composition` (element fractions as a compact formula string) and
column `target` (the measured critical temperature Tc (K)).

turns.answer_text:
The data indicate that high Tc is concentrated in oxygen-rich cuprates. Within the available elements, the most promising low-complexity choice is undoped, fully oxygenated Y–Ba–Cu–O. The nearby training samples contain Zn, La, Ca, or oxygen deficiency, all of which are associated with substantially lower Tc. Removing those substitutions and using the canonical YBa₂Cu₃O₇ stoichiometry should place Tc near 90 K.

Normalizing YBa₂Cu₃O₇ by its total of 13 atoms gives Y=1/13, Ba=2/13, Cu=3/13, and O=7/13.
